description.value:
The fullest exchange you can manage in a single breath. Choose how many actions to spend (1, 2, or 3); you regain three times that many expended spell slots (3, 6, or 9), distributed across any ranks of jutsu you can normally cast. You cannot regain a slot of higher rank than your maximum spell rank.

Frequency consumes one daily use of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtChakraReser0]{Chakra Reserves} (shared with all Charge Chakra variants).

Requires the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtMastrChakra0]{Master Chakra Caster} class feature.
